description: Source code implementing certificate revocation checking logic, including OCSP and CRL validation, for the Chromium project.

methods.name: MarkCertificateRevoked
methods.description: Marks a certificate as revoked by adding an error to the provided CertErrors object.

methods.name: CheckCertRevocation
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a specific certificate in a chain, using OCSP and CRL, according to the provided policy.

methods.name: CheckValidatedChainRevocation
methods.description: Iterates over a chain of certificates to perform revocation checks on each, from root to leaf, and records errors.

methods.name: CheckChainRevocationUsingCRLSet
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a chain of certificates against a CRLSet, considering SPKI, subject, and serial number.
